summary: Next.js Migration Regression Testing - CRITICAL ISSUE: Client-side hydration not working. SSR renders correctly (all routes return 200, meta tags, JSON-LD present), but React is not loading on client side. useEffect hooks not running, API calls not being made. Backend API working correctly (44/44 pytest tests passed). Admin login API works. This appears to be a Next.js 16 Turbopack hydration issue in the preview environment.

critical.issue: React is not loading on client side. typeof React === 'undefined'. No Next.js globals found (window.__NEXT_DATA__, window.__next). useEffect hooks not executing. API calls not being made from client.
critical.affected_pages: All pages - Homepage, Truck Detail, Inquiry, etc.
critical.evidence: Manual fetch('/api/trucks') works and returns 6 trucks, but React components don't make API calls

critical.issue: Truck detail page shows infinite loading spinner because API call is not made (useEffect not running due to hydration failure)

integration_issues.issue: All dynamic content (trucks, FAQs, reviews, blog posts) not loading because client-side JavaScript not executing

action_items: CRITICAL: Investigate and fix client-side hydration issue - React not loading on client
Check if this is a Next.js 16 Turbopack issue or preview environment specific
Consider building for production (next build && next start) instead of dev mode
Check if there's a JavaScript error preventing React from initializing
Verify that all 'use client' directives are correctly placed
Check for any SSR/client mismatch that could cause hydration to fail silently
critical_code_review_comments: SSR is working correctly - all meta tags, JSON-LD, OpenGraph tags present in HTML
Backend API fully functional - 44/44 tests passed
The issue is specifically with client-side JavaScript execution/hydration
Leaflet SSR error in AdminRoutes.js (window is not defined) - may need dynamic import with ssr:false
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL: Client-side hydration is broken. SSR works perfectly (all routes 200, meta tags present, HTML content rendered). But React is not loading on client side - typeof React === 'undefined', no Next.js globals found. This means useEffect hooks don't run and no API calls are made. The issue appears to be specific to Next.js 16 Turbopack in dev mode. Consider: 1) Building for production, 2) Checking for silent JavaScript errors, 3) Verifying 'use client' directives, 4) Checking for hydration mismatches.
